newsitem.title: GERMANY: German draft share law - management board.
newsitem.headline: German draft share law - management board.

text.p: The German Justice Ministry on Tuesday released details of a new draft share law. The following is a summary of the sections of the draft referring to management boards.
The summary was provided by the ministry in German and translated by Reuters.
* Risk management - the management board of joint stock companies (Aktiengesellschaften or AGs) are required to ensure there is adequate risk management and internal auditing within the company.
* The reporting requirements of the management board with regard to future company strategy will be strengthened.
